summary: The commit changes the score calculation to use integer division before converting to float, which truncates the ratio and also introduces a panic on zero total, altering runtime behavior and introducing defects.

findings.explanation: Integer division truncates the ratio before conversion, so scorePercentage(1,3) returns 0 instead of 33.33, losing precision.
Using integer division causes a runtime panic when total is zero, whereas the previous float division would produce +Inf; this adds a new crash scenario.
